metadata.description: Test M4 origin contour and time window fixture constructed from real M5 Phase 1 AIS dataset for Phase 2 integration testing.

condition_1_inside_50_contour_and_time_w.expected_filter_result: MATCH - Candidate vessel inside 50% origin contour during origin time window.

condition_2_inside_90_contour_outside_50.expected_filter_result: MATCH - Candidate vessel inside 90% origin contour (outside 50%) during origin time window.

condition_3_spatially_near_contour_outsi.expected_filter_result: EXCLUDED - Vessel spatially intersects 90% contour zone but timestamp (11:22 UTC) is ~2h prior to origin time window (13:30-14:30 UTC).

condition_4_satisfying_both_spatial_and_.expected_filter_result: MATCH - Both vessels satisfy spatial containment and temporal window overlapping requirements.

condition_5_ais_gap_overlapping_time_win.expected_filter_result: GAP OVERLAP MATCH - AIS gap (09:32 to 19:25 UTC) spans the origin time window (13:30 to 14:30 UTC); candidate flag set for trajectory gap interpolation testing.
